name: Cham villages on the Hau
nameVi: Làng Chăm Châu Phong và Đa Phước
kicker: Two Cham villages on the Hậu
summary: Châu Phong and Đa Phước are Cham villages on two banks of the Hậu, a half day if you combine them with the fish rafts. You visit a mosque, walk stilt houses, and can watch weaving that the province lists as national intangible heritage. The gate in the photograph is Jamiul Azhar, which the province places in Châu Phong. Mubarak is also in Châu Phong. It is not the name of every mosque. Gates are check on arrival.
timeNeeded: Half a day with the rafts
getThere: By boat or road from town. Minutes were not printed.
heroCaption: The gate of Jamiul Azhar, a mosque the province places in Châu Phong

notice.title: One mosque name does not fit every village
notice.body: The province places Mubarak, Jamiul Azhar, and Nia’mah in Châu Phong, and Ihsan and Sunnah in Đa Phước. The photograph is the Jamiul Azhar gate. Do not caption the other mosques with that name.

body: Cross the Hậu for the villages, not for a second copy of the town market. The province names Châu Phong in then thị xã Tân Châu, and Đa Phước in then huyện An Phú. Vietnam Tourism’s English guide says Châu Giang and Châu Phong sit on two islets across the river and names the Mubarak mosque. The 2024 province article is the one that places Mubarak in Châu Phong, as a national-level architectural monument. This pass did not find a 2026 commune page that still uses Châu Giang as the official name. The names stay separate.

Walk the stilt houses and the boardwalks, and watch the weaving. The province says the weaving in Châu Phong is a national intangible cultural heritage, recorded with lifecycle rituals at the end of 2023. Vietnam Tourism describes veils, sarongs, and prayers five times a day. Prayer times are not a visitor timetable on these pages. Bánh bò Chăm, cooked under a hot clay lid, belongs to this visit. A licensed photograph of that cake was not found, so it is not a card.

The second photograph is another Cham mosque near Châu Đốc. The file names the community and does not say which of the five mosques it is, so the caption does not invent one. Mosque and workshop gates were not given a tariff. Check on arrival.
